notes: Godot 4.0 tower defense for Godot Wild Jam #60 (theme: Malfunction). Five towers with unique attack and malfunction behaviour, three waves, buy/upgrade UI. Upstream HTML5 export under docs/ (index.wasm, index.pck, and companion web files) is omitted from this snapshot. No bundled fonts or audio. icon.svg is an original ochre-tower-and-turret mark (md5 628bf39967d8b98da6b2523186e41674), replacing the Godot default project icon. No Git LFS, no addons, no editor .tmp.
